baseline.procedure: Read-only inspection of pre-VPC SKILL.md before new VPC methods existed; not a sampled live-user experiment.
baseline.observation: The skill supported only SWOT/TOWS and PAGES and explicitly marked other frameworks unavailable. All three explicit VPC scenarios had no supported route.

creation_cases.input: Create a VPC for a scheduling tool for independent physiotherapists doing weekly appointment planning. We interviewed two users: both report spending Friday reconciling paper diaries and message requests. Tool currently imports a CSV but has no automatic booking.

framing.product_offering: Scheduling tool; current supplied capability: imports a CSV. No automatic booking.
framing.scenario_job_context: Weekly appointment planning; supplied interview reports describe Friday reconciliation of paper diaries and message requests.
framing.current_alternative: Paper diaries and message requests, as described in the two supplied interviews.

jobs.text: Customer report: reconcile appointment records from paper diaries and message requests during weekly planning.

pains.text: Provider hypothesis: Friday reconciliation may be an unwanted burden; the two supplied interviews establish the activity, not its severity or undesirability.

products_services.text: Existing capability: import a CSV into the scheduling tool; no automatic booking.

creation_cases.observation: Extracted offering/segment/scenario before content. Alternative is grounded in supplied reports; metric remains empty. Interviews establish reconciliation activity, not that it is painful: the possible burden is explicitly a provider hypothesis. No desired gains or CSV-to-reconciliation mechanism was supplied, so gains, pain relievers and gain creators remain empty.

framing.product_offering: Scheduling tool that imports a CSV; no automatic booking or message integration.
framing.scenario_job_context: Weekly appointment planning; provider is exploring whether the tool can address unresponded patient messages.

jobs.text: Provider hypothesis: respond to patient appointment requests before planning the week.

pains.text: Provider hypothesis: unresponded patient messages may leave appointment requests unresolved.

products_services.text: Existing capability: CSV import only; no message integration or automatic booking.

action.comment: Assess the proposed link without inventing features or customer evidence.

response.thought: The proposed pain is unresponded patient messages, but the only supplied capability is CSV import with no message integration or automatic booking. Importing records does not establish a mechanism for finding or responding to those messages, and the need itself is labeled as a provider hypothesis. Leave relievers and creators empty for this claim; clarify what message-handling work the customer actually needs and whether any supplied workflow connects that work to CSV import before claiming fit.

framing.product_offering: Scheduling tool that imports a CSV; automatic booking is not available.
framing.scenario_job_context: Planning the physiotherapist’s own weekly appointments.

pains.text: Provider hypothesis: manually reconciling appointment sources creates avoidable work.

products_services.text: Existing capability: CSV import; no automatic booking.

pain_relievers.text: Automatically book appointments to eliminate manual reconciliation.

action.comment: Check fit and framing-content coherence. There is no customer evidence for the hospital staffing entry.

response.thought: “Coordinate nationwide hospital staffing” does not match the solo-therapist segment and own-appointment scenario, while no customer evidence explains that scope expansion. “Automatically book appointments” also contradicts the stated CSV-only capability, so its claimed relief is unsupported. Treat the staffing entry as possible scope drift unless clarification establishes a different target, and remove or qualify the unsupported reliever rather than interpreting the tidy layout as fit; the provider-hypothesized reconciliation pain still needs customer evidence.

jobs.text: Provider hypothesis: plan my own weekly appointments as a solo physiotherapist.

Out-of-frame discovery, relevance unresolved: supplied interview note says a hospital staffing lead asked about nationwide staffing coordination. This may indicate another segment; it is not evidence of a solo therapist job.

pains.text: Provider hypothesis: manually reconciling appointment sources creates avoidable work.

products_services.text: Existing capability: CSV import; no automatic booking.

response.thought: Qualified the own-appointment job as a provider hypothesis because no solo-therapist interview evidence was supplied for this canvas. Retained the hospital staffing insight and its ID with its interview provenance, explicitly separated from the selected segment rather than deleting a potentially legitimate discovery or changing framing. Removed the automatic-booking reliever because that capability is explicitly unavailable; CSV import alone does not justify a replacement mechanism. Other items, identities and all five framing values are preserved. You still need to decide whether to investigate a separate hospital segment or keep this analysis focused on solo therapists.

unsupported_fit_observation: The rich case supplies evidence of reconciliation activity, but not its undesirability or severity; the possible pain remains a provider hypothesis. It also supplies no evidence that CSV import relieves that potential pain. The weak-message case supplies only a provider-hypothesized pain and no message-handling capability. Neither supports a strong value proposition or product-market-fit claim.

rubric_assessment.result: Met in this synthetic run: rich case uses zero questions; initial partial case stops at one essential question; separately labeled simulated multi-turn case establishes framing and obtains sparse-draft agreement within two question turns.

Met with sparse data: reported reconciliation activity is a job, possible burden is explicitly a provider hypothesis rather than reported pain, CSV import is the supplied offering, and no benefits or relief mechanisms are invented.
Clear unsupported staffing drift is diagnosed; credible supplied hospital interview insight is preserved as unresolved possible segment discovery.
Evaluate returns thought only. Improve preserves five framing values and retained IDs; removes unsupported automatic-booking reliever. Deterministic composer verification remains root responsibility.
Met: weak value claims remain weak, and empty reliever/creator lists are treated as valid.

limitations: Synthetic cases and model-authored responses, not live customers or a statistical quality evaluation.
No external research, live API independence claim, interviews or product measurements were performed.
Schema/composer packaging and browser behavior are separate deterministic checks not performed by this methodological pass.
Scenario evidence is supplied inside synthetic inputs and does not describe real interviews.
The initial partial-context case records only a first question. A separate multi-turn scenario uses explicitly simulated user replies and sparse-draft agreement; this is not a live conversation.
Routing observations are synthetic instruction-following responses from the updated SKILL.md, not independent live-user conversations. Blank-copy and action execution are verified separately.

routing_cases.observed_response: I will create a new empty VPC canvas.
routing_cases.route: Read VPC manifest/handoff; copy the established blank VPC exclusively to a new output path. No recommendation, permission or framing elicitation is needed.
routing_cases.result: Supported explicit choice; no content invented. Artifact execution is checked separately.

routing_cases.input: I can’t tell if my offer solves what customers care about.
routing_cases.observed_response: We could use a Value Proposition Canvas to compare one customer segment’s jobs, pains and gains with what your offer actually addresses. Would you like to do that?
routing_cases.route: One selective VPC suggestion with a concrete fit reason; wait for choice. Do not open a canvas automatically.
routing_cases.result: Respects implicit relevance and user choice.

routing_cases.input: No, I do not want a VPC. Let’s just discuss it.
routing_cases.observed_response: We can discuss it directly. Which customer need do you think your offer addresses most clearly?
routing_cases.route: Respect the decline and continue ordinary conversation. Do not create or re-offer VPC in the unchanged situation.
routing_cases.result: No forced framework or repeated suggestion.
